images.title: Convert, then reason
images.purpose: Shows a 200 ft by 500 ft plot being converted to acres before finding the tonnes of manure.
images.composition: A rectangle on the left and two arrows leading to two boxes on the right, in one row. Plain white background, lots of empty space around the main object, no scenery, no people, no extra text.
images.exact_structure: Left: a green (#009E73) outlined rectangle 500 units wide and 200 units high with '500 ft' under the long side, '200 ft' beside the short side, and '100000 sq ft' inside. A dark outline colour (#2B2B2B) arrow labelled '÷ 43560' leads to a teal (#0072B2) box '? acres'. A second dark outline colour arrow labelled '× 10 tonnes' leads to a reddish purple (#CC79A7) box '? tonnes'. Exactly 1 rectangle, 2 arrows, 2 boxes.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
images.takeaway: Convert to the unit of the rate first, then use the proportion.
images.description: Shows a 200 ft by 500 ft plot being converted to acres before finding the tonnes of manure.

image_decisions.why: The practice is one chain, convert then scale, and one row of steps shows it without clutter.
